- "0.64x Net Debt/ Equity (as of Mar'26)" per the 'At a glance' slide; the Key Ratios chart shows net debt to equity of 0.8, 0.5, 0.0, 0.2, 0.6 for FY22-FY26 and interest coverage of 8.2, 11.7, 18.1, 14.4, 6.2 over the same years.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Founded in 1997, described as "a prominent industrial packaging company known for our polymer-based molded products", specialising in rigid Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBCs), Polymer Drums and Mild Steel Drums used by the chemical, agrochemical, specialty chemical and pharmaceutical industries.
- Well-diversified client base: "Top Customer contributes 6% to revenues and top10 together accounts for 29%", across 500+ customers and 500+ workforce, with a fleet of 99 trucks and pan-India presence.
- Quality/compliance as a moat: IBCs and MS Drums carry UN certification conforming to IS 1783:2014, plus IIP (Govt of India) approval and international TUV certification of IBC from TUV Singapore; the deck also cites IBC collection services in the USA and Europe.
- Comprehensive portfolio positioned as "complete bulk industrial packaging solutions" - IBCs (1,000 L, four pallet types), plastic barrels/HDPE drums from 20 L to 250 L and higher, and MS drums of 200-210 L.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [FY27 guidance] The "Strategic Roadmap for FY27" sets an expected outcome of revenue growth ~15% and EBITDA margin ~11%-12%.
- [War impact] The deck repeatedly flags an external demand shock: "Near-term volume hit by the war; capacity and per-tn profitability unaffected" and "IBC volumes were specifically hit as export demand suffered due to the war", partly offset by MS Drums (+51% YoY) and IBC-Polymer (+7%).
- [Milestones] Journey slide: incorporation 1997, production of polymer drums at Silvassa 1998, IBC production at Bharuch, MS drums at Bharuch, Rs 400 Cr turnover in 2023, conversion to public limited, Wada operations commenced 2025, and solar power & recycling plant operations commenced 2026.
- [Promoter-led board] Leadership is family-led - Mr. Bijaykumar Agarwal (MD & Chairman, three decades in packaging), Mr. Jaiprakash Agarwal (WTD & CFO, 19 years) and Mrs. Madhu Agarwal (WTD).
